requirements.quote: Any Proposer responding to this RFP must complete the Non-Collusive Proposal Certification attached hereto at Exhibit B and submit it to the Authority with its proposal.
requirements.text: Proposers must complete and submit the Non-Collusive Proposal Certification.

requirements.quote: Any and all exceptions to this RFP must be clearly and completely indicated in proposals submitted.
requirements.text: Proposers must clearly indicate any exceptions to the RFP in their proposals.

requirements.quote: The proposers’ costs for the proposers entire submittal effort shall be borne by the proposer.
requirements.text: Proposers must bear all costs associated with their proposal submission.

requirements.quote: The selected Proposer will be required to comply with and perform its services under the contract in accordance with any and all Whistleblower Policy and Procedures adopted by the Authority.
requirements.text: Selected proposers must comply with the Authority's Whistleblower Policy and Procedures.

requirements.quote: Proposers’ utilization of M/WBE’s and SDVOB’s is a factor in awarding projects and imposes obligations on a selected proposer to utilize M/WBE’s and SDVOB’s in performance of contracts with the Authority.
requirements.text: Proposers must utilize M/WBE and SDVOB entities in contract performance.
